summary.tldr: Creates a new complaints and review body for the RCMP and CBSA, and updates related federal laws and references.
what_it_does: Replaces the Civilian Review and Complaints Commission for the RCMP with a new independent body called the Public Complaints and Review Commission.
Lets the commission review and investigate complaints about the conduct and level of service of RCMP and Canada Border Services Agency personnel.
Lets the commission review specified activities of the RCMP and the Canada Border Services Agency.
Allows the commission chairperson to recommend disciplinary steps for people who were the subject of complaints.
Amends the Canada Border Services Agency Act to cover investigations of serious incidents involving CBSA officers and employees.
Replaces the word “Force” with “RCMP” in the English versions of federal statutes, orders, regulations and other instruments, and makes related changes to other Acts.
who_it_affects: The Public Complaints and Review Commission
summary.background: The bill would replace the Civilian Review and Complaints Commission for the RCMP with a new independent body. It also makes related amendments to the Canada Border Services Agency Act and other federal laws.
